Amendment to Rule 81 of the Telangana Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 - Final Notification - Order
ORDER:
Government vide G.O 9th read above, had issued a preliminary notification to
amend Rule 81 of the Telangana Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 to enhance the fee for
reservation of special numbers and the same was published in the Telangana Gazette
vide No.G-575 Part-I Extraordinary, dated 13.08.2025 for the information of the general
public, as required under sub-section(1) of section 212 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (
Central Act,No.59 of 1988) , duly calling the objections or suggestions within Thirty (30)
days.

Amendment to Rule 81 of the Telangana Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 - Final Notification - Paragraph 3 - Accordingly, the following notification shall be published in an extraordinary (part 1 of 2)
3. Accordingly, the following notification shall be published in an extraordinary
issue of the Telangana Gazette, dated:15.11.2025.
NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 65 of the Motor Vehicles
Act, 1988 (Central Act No.59 of 1988), the Government of Telangana hereby
makes the following amendment to the Telangana Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989,
issued vide G.O.Ms.No.216, Transport, Roads & Buildings (Transport-II)
Department, dated: 07.08.1989 and published in the Rules Supplement to Part-I
Extra-Ordinary issue of the Telangana Gazette, dated:25.08.1989, and as
subsequently amended from time to time, the same having been previously
published as required under sub-section (1) of section 212 of the Motor Vehicle
Act,1988(Central Act.No.59 of 1988).
(P.T.O)
-2-
AMENDMENT
In the said rules, in rule 81,
1. sub-rule (1), (2) and (4) shall be omitted.
2. for sub-rule (3), the following shall be substituted, namely,-
“(3) The Registering Authority may on an application made to it
through | online | in | the | Transport | Department | portal | i.e.
www.transport.telangana.gov.in | by | owner | of | the | vehicle,
reserve the special numbers within thousand from the last
number assigned in serial order on the date of application.
i. On payment of fee of Rs.1,50,000/- (Rupees One lakh Fifty thousand
only) for the number (9999);
ii. On payment of fee of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lakh only) for any one
of the numbers (1,9,6666);
iii. On payment of fee of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) for any
one of the numbers (99, 999, 3333, 4444, 5555,7777);
iv. On payment of fee of Rs.40,000/- (Rupees Forty thousand only) for any
one of the numbers (5,6,7,123, 333, 369, 555, 666, 777, 1111,
1116,1234,2222,2277,2345,2727,3339,3366,3456,3699,4455, 4545 , 4599,
6669,6789,8055, 8888);
v. On payment of fee of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees thirty thousand only) for any
one of the numbers (3,111,234, 567,1188, 1818, 1899, 1999, 2799,
3636,3999,5678, 5999, 6999, 7999, 9009);
vi. On payment of fee of Rs.20,000 /- (Rupees twenty thousand only) for
any one of the numbers (2, 4, 8, 11,18, 27, 36, 39, 45, 55, 77, 143, 222,
405, 444,456,459, 786, 789, 909, 1112, 1122, 1212, 1233, 1269, 1314, 1359,
1889, | 2223, | 2255, | 2259, | 2349, | 2525, | 3335, | 3344,3399,3555,3789,
3888,3969, | 4446, | 4554, | 4567, | 4777, | 4959, | 5445,5559,5589,5599,
5666,5679, 5859, 6336, 6699, 6777, 6786, 6969, 7779, 7799, 7979,
8889, 8899, 8999, 9099) ;
vii. On payment of fee of Rs.6,000/- (Rupees Six thousand only) for any
one of the numbers other than those mentioned against the clause
(i),(ii),(iii),(iv),(v) and (vi) above in respect of all vehicles except two
wheelers for which a fee of Rs.3000/- shall be charged ;
Provided that any current number can be reserved on payment of
Rs.2000/- (Rupees Two Thousand only).
viii. The application for reservation of numbers shall be submitted online in
the Department portal www.transport.telangana. gov.in by paying the
requisite fee online from 8.00am to 1.00pm. No application shall be
received personally under any circumstances.
3. For sub-rule (5) the following shall be substituted, namely :-
(i) If there is more than one application for a particular registration
number, the reservation shall be made by way of submitting the bids
online from 2.00pm to 4.00pm. The number shall be allotted to the
highest offer for those who have filed bids.
-3-
(ii) If any applicant has not submitted the bid, the fee shall be forfeited.

Amendment to Rule 81 of the Telangana Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 - Final Notification - Paragraph 4 - For sub-rule (6) the following shall be substituted, namely
4. For sub-rule (6) the following shall be substituted, namely:-
“The number reserved under sub rules (3) (i), (ii), (iii), (iv),(v),(vi),(vii) shall
be allotted on production of the vehicle and registered as per the procedure
prescribed in the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 and rules made there under. The
reservation shall be cancelled if the vehicle is not produced within fifteen
(15) days from the date of reserving the number. The number reserved shall
be re-notified immediately and the procedure as per sub rules (3)
(i),(ii),(iii),(iv),(v),(vi) and (vii) shall be followed after cancellation of the
reservation. If no applicant applies for the number or numbers, the said
number or numbers shall be referred to the Transport Commissioner at
intervals decided by him for re-notification or further action”.
(BY ORDER AND IN THE NAME OF THE GOVERNOR OF TELANGANA)
VIKAS RAJ
SPECIAL CHIEF SECRETARY TO GOVERNMENT
To
The Commissioner of Printing, Stationery & Stores Purchase, Telangana, Hyderabad
(He is requested to publish the Notification in the Extraordinary issue of Telangana
Gazette dated:15.11.2025 and send 100 copies to the Transport Commissioner,
Hyderabad and 50 copies to the Government)
The Transport Commissioner, Telangana State, Hyderabad
The Director of information and public relations, Hyderabad
Copy to:
The P.S to Prl. Secretary to Hon’ble Chief Minister.
The OSD to Hon’ble Minister (Transport & BCW)
The P.S. to Special Chief Secretary to Government, Transport, R& B Dept.
The Law (C ) Dept.
Sf/Sc.
//FORWARDED:: BY ORDER//
SECTION OFFICER
